**Operating Temperature Range**

The NE301 operates from **−20°C to +50°C**, a range rated for extreme outdoor environments and covered by the IP67-rated enclosure. [1]

This range also covers refrigerated deployments, including standard refrigerated cabinets (2°C–8°C), dairy cases, and freezers (−18°C). For ultra-low cold storage conditions, environmental monitoring via the sensor expansion board can validate deployment feasibility. [2]

**Low-Temperature Battery Note**

At −20°C, effective alkaline AA battery capacity drops approximately 25–35% versus room temperature. For cold-climate deployments, CamThink recommends lithium AA cells, which retain roughly 85–90% capacity at −20°C. [3]
